title: AI_ORCHESTRA Worker Report
description: Structured result returned by a worker agent after executing a bounded task. Claims made here must be independently verifiable.

status.description: Worker self-reported outcome. Not an authorization to publish.

files_changed.description: Repository-relative paths the worker believes it modified. Verified independently against Git.

tests.description: Result of the test command executed by the worker, when tests were run.

passed.description: Number of passing tests, when the framework reports counts.

failed.description: Number of failing tests, when the framework reports counts.

summary.description: Concise description of what was done. Must not contain source-code dumps.

questions.description: Open questions requiring reviewer or human resolution.
